title: E0124: Weak hash for passwords
plain_english: Hashing passwords with weak algorithms such as MD5, SHA1, or `crypt()` does not provide adequate protection for password storage. Use a dedicated password hashing function instead.
why_matters: Weak password hashing makes it easier for attackers to: - Crack password hashes quickly using rainbow tables or brute-force attacks - Recover common passwords in a short time - Compromise many accounts if a password database is exposed
bad_example:
$hash = md5($password);       // weak, fast, unsalted
$hash = sha1($password);      // weak, fast, unsalted
$hash = crypt($password);     // weak, may use DES-based crypt
